name: Enabot ROLA Mini
description: A small, self-righting rolling camera robot with a 2K night-vision camera, two-way audio, and a physical call button — built and marketed by Enabot primarily as a pet-monitoring device, with one recurring marketing line about elder care but no dedicated senior-specific hardware or software.

specs.label: Detection
specs.note: person/pet triggers auto-clips; no SLAM mapping

sourcing: Verified against Enabot's own store pages (ROLA Mini, ROLA PetPal, EBO Air, EBO X), retailer listings (Target, Best Buy, Home Depot, B&H), and independent reviews (The AU Review, ToolSmarts.ca). Two things are flagged for reconsideration rather than stated as settled: the "New & Pending" tag looks inconsistent with a product that has shipped continuously since late 2024, and the "Senior Companions" categorization rests on a single reused marketing sentence in Enabot's own materials rather than a dedicated senior-care feature — EBO X, already catalogued under Security, has the more substantive elder-care claim (a named fall-alert feature). No independent review discusses ROLA Mini as a senior-monitoring product; all treat it as a pet camera.

pricing.summary: Listed at $169 direct from Enabot, with periodic promotional pricing seen around $139; a UK launch price of £149 was also reported. It's stocked at Target, Best Buy, Home Depot, B&H, Chewy, and other major retailers — a normal, broadly-distributed retail SKU rather than a pre-order or crowdfunded item (see the caveat below on the "New & Pending" tag).

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware — Category Fit Worth Questioning
editorial.body: Enabot markets ROLA Mini under its pet-focused "PetTech" line, not the elder-care "FamilyBot" line, and independent reviews treat it purely as a pet camera; its only elder-care claim is one boilerplate marketing sentence, with no fall detection or medication reminders, raising doubts about its "Senior Companions" listing. Hardware includes a self-righting tumbler design, tracked-wheel mobility, and a call-button two-way-audio feature.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: ROLA Mini is marketed under Enabot's "Senior Companions" category, but no independent review — including The AU Review and ToolSmarts.ca — evaluates it as a senior-monitoring device; all treat it strictly as a pet camera. Its "New & Pending" listing tag is also inconsistent with a product that has shipped continuously since late 2024.

firmwareCommunity.note: Enabot has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API for ROLA Mini. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
